# BYZ scope. Quiet enough for the company (design 3.2): the colonisation line's oe_col_calm (the City held, no civil war, no crisis of the vassal line) and the City not under Bayezid's blockade.
oe_cmp_calm = {
    oe_col_calm = yes
    oe_byd_running = no
}

# BYZ scope. The empire has granted the charter.
oe_cmp_has = {
    has_variable = oe_cmp_holder
}

# BYZ scope. The charter's preconditions (design 3.2): the colonisation line has opened its trading posts (oe_col_c_open), 12 months with at least one post, from 1352.1.1, calm.
oe_cmp_can_charter = {
    has_variable = oe_col_c_open
    has_variable = oe_cmp_ready_m
    var:oe_cmp_ready_m >= 12
    current_date >= 1352.1.1
    oe_cmp_calm = yes
}

# BYZ scope. GEN can be the partner of charter c (design 3.4): D1 keeps its books (oe_itp_on), its privilege tier is at least 2, the Galata chain is not running, it exists and is not at war with the empire.
oe_cmp_ok_gen = {
    has_variable = oe_itp_on
    oe_itp_gal_running = no
    oe_itp_tier_ge = { r = gen n = 2 }
    country_exists = c:GEN
    c:GEN = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } }
}

# BYZ scope. VEN can be the partner of charter c (design 3.4): D1 keeps its books (oe_itp_on), its privilege tier is at least 2, the Galata chain is not running, it exists and is not at war with the empire.
oe_cmp_ok_ven = {
    has_variable = oe_itp_on
    oe_itp_gal_running = no
    oe_itp_tier_ge = { r = ven n = 2 }
    country_exists = c:VEN
    c:VEN = { NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } }
}

# BYZ scope. Genoa's privilege tier is at least Venice's (tiers 0-3 of D1).
oe_cmp_gen_ge_ven = {
    NOT = {
        OR = {
            AND = { oe_itp_tier_ge = { r = ven n = 3 } NOT = { oe_itp_tier_ge = { r = gen n = 3 } } }
            AND = { oe_itp_tier_ge = { r = ven n = 2 } NOT = { oe_itp_tier_ge = { r = gen n = 2 } } }
            AND = { oe_itp_tier_ge = { r = ven n = 1 } NOT = { oe_itp_tier_ge = { r = gen n = 1 } } }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Charter c goes to Genoa: it qualifies and Venice does not, or Genoa's tier is at least Venice's (design 3.16: the higher tier; a tie goes to Genoa).
oe_cmp_pick_gen = {
    oe_cmp_ok_gen = yes
    OR = { NOT = { oe_cmp_ok_ven = yes } oe_cmp_gen_ge_ven = yes }
}

# BYZ scope. Charter c goes to Venice.
oe_cmp_pick_ven = {
    oe_cmp_ok_ven = yes
    NOT = { oe_cmp_pick_gen = yes }
}

# BYZ scope. This line may send an event: the main-line month is free and 6 quiet months have passed since its last event.

# Location scope. One of our posts is here or next door (the colonisation line keeps oe_col_post on the site of each of the empire's posts).
oe_cmp_by_post = {
    OR = { has_variable = oe_col_post any_neighbor_location = { has_variable = oe_col_post } }
}

# Location scope. Land the Company may ask for (design 3.10): coastal, with an owner that is not the empire, outside the imperial bloc, not at war with us and not cooling after a refusal; not that owner's capital; not besieged; Tana and Caffa not after Gazaria's fall (the colonisation line's oe_col_site_fallen).
oe_cmp_tgt_base = {
    is_coastal = yes
    has_owner = yes
    NOT = { owner ?= c:BYZ }
    owner ?= {
        NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes }
        NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ }
        NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_no_cd }
    }
    NOT = { is_capital = yes }
    NOT = { has_siege = yes }
    NOT = { oe_col_site_fallen = yes }
}

    var:oe_col_post ?= 1
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_post_susp }
}

# BYZ scope. Land may be bought now: generator switch LAND, fewer than 4 locations bought, 60 months since the last.

    OR = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_land_n } var:oe_cmp_land_n < 4 }
    OR = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_land_next } var:oe_cmp_land_next <= oe_ml_month_now }
}

# Location scope. Land: not a site with our level-1 post (that one is offered as a quarter), at or next to one of our posts, and land may be bought now.
oe_cmp_tgt_l = {

    oe_cmp_by_post = yes
    c:BYZ = { oe_cmp_land_open = yes }

# Location scope. The Company's fund covers the price of this target (oe_cmp_price).
oe_cmp_afford = {
    OR = {
        AND = { oe_cmp_tgt_q = yes c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_cmp_fund var:oe_cmp_fund >= oe_cmp_price_q } }
        AND = {
            NOT = { oe_cmp_tgt_q = yes }
            location_rank = location_rank:rural_settlement
            c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_cmp_fund var:oe_cmp_fund >= oe_cmp_price_rural_settlement }
        }
        AND = {
            NOT = { oe_cmp_tgt_q = yes }
            location_rank = location_rank:town
            c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_cmp_fund var:oe_cmp_fund >= oe_cmp_price_town }
        }
        AND = {
            NOT = { oe_cmp_tgt_q = yes }
            location_rank = location_rank:city
            c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_cmp_fund var:oe_cmp_fund >= oe_cmp_price_city }
        }
        AND = {
            NOT = { oe_cmp_tgt_q = yes }
            location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis
            c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_cmp_fund var:oe_cmp_fund >= oe_cmp_price_megalopolis }
        }
    }
}

# Country scope. A ruler the Company may protect (design 3.10): an AI, not the empire, nobody's subject, not at war with us, outside the imperial bloc, at most 8 locations, its capital on the coast of the Black Sea or the Levant (balkan_region, carpathia_region, steppes_region, caucasus_region, anatolia_region, crescent_region, egypt_region).
oe_cmp_prot_fit = {
    is_ai = yes
    NOT = { tag = BYZ }
    is_subject = no
    NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ }
    NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes }
    NOT = { any_owned_location = { count >= 9 } }
    capital ?= {
        is_coastal = yes
        OR = {
            region = region:balkan_region
            region = region:carpathia_region
            region = region:steppes_region
            region = region:caucasus_region
            region = region:anatolia_region
            region = region:crescent_region
            region = region:egypt_region
        }
    }
}

# Country scope. A ruler the Company may offer protection now: fit, not protected yet, not cooling after a refusal.

    NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_no_cd }
}

# Country scope. A protected ruler stays protected: nobody's subject, not at war with us, outside the imperial bloc.
oe_cmp_prot_keep = {

    NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ }
    NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes }
}

# BYZ scope. The action 订保护约 may be used (design 3.10): stage 2, calm, no request waiting, fewer than 3 protected rulers, the fund pays a year, a ruler to offer it to.
oe_cmp_can_protect = {
    oe_cmp_has = yes
    oe_cmp_stage2_on = yes
    oe_cmp_calm = yes
    oe_cmp_req_none = yes
    OR = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_prot_n } var:oe_cmp_prot_n < 3 }
    has_variable = oe_cmp_fund
    var:oe_cmp_fund >= oe_cmp_prot_fee
    any_country = { oe_cmp_prot_new = yes }
}
